column1: # Safety audit of a Claude-only draft: a QA record, not the council's back-translation.

column3: Names the setting «Toppfart», but in this draft Toppfart is the measured top speed on a trip or ride; the setting being capped is shown as «Maksimal fart» (controls_feature_maximum_speed), so a rider is sent to a setting name that does not exist. Style guide section 7 holds this key in English until the D3 terminology fix.
